findings.actual_failure: dispatch answers start for a spec the base refused with invalid_workspace
findings.observation: A workspace.toml with a non-table section (backlog = "x"), a non-canonical initiative slug ([ini-abc]) or a non-table initiative subsection, which the base dispatch refused as invalid_workspace, is now accepted; the port dropped global_invalid_workspace.
findings.reachable_path: argless dispatch, --start or --resume, the MCP workspace_status() tool, or the navigate-intents bridge over such a hand-edited workspace.toml

findings.actual_failure: blocked and decision.findings differ from the base on an entry-free repository
findings.observation: A spec whose Brief: header is an unsafe path is no longer validated through the source-record parser, so it lands in blocked with two invalid_artifact_path findings where the base emitted one top-level invalid_artifact_path and listed nothing.
findings.reachable_path: any dispatch run or the MCP tool over a spec with Brief: ../outside.md, an absolute path, a backslash path or a URL
findings.rule_ref: plan.md Design: the port keeps each function's base semantics

findings.actual_failure: the unsupported_legacy finding disappears and dispatch answers as if the entry were absent
findings.observation: A string-valued registry collection (executing = "docs/product/briefs/x.md"), which the base engine read as an entry and reported as unsupported_legacy, is neither refused nor reported.
findings.reachable_path: any dispatch run over a workspace.toml with a string-valued collection
findings.rule_ref: spec Outcome: unmigrated entries are refused, never silently answered

findings.actual_failure: dispatch refuses permanently with no route out the repair offers
findings.observation: Legacy string or slug-table entries (open = ["spec/alpha"]) make dispatch refuse with unmigrated_workspace, but repair-plan plans no operation and no manual item for them, so following the next action leaves dispatch refusing.
findings.reachable_path: an adopter with legacy-form entries who follows the unmigrated_workspace next action

findings.actual_failure: the agent runs retired tooling that exits 2
findings.observation: work-intake's references/lifecycle-index.md still tells agents to run repair-plan --migration-selection, the migration repair-apply and repair-rollback, describes [authorization.migration] confirmations, and says legacy entries surface as unsupported_legacy.
findings.reachable_path: an agent loading work-intake's lifecycle reference
findings.rule_ref: AC-0008, AC-0009; AGENTS.md: report stale instructions

findings.actual_failure: a regression in the unmigrated predicate passes the replay suite
findings.observation: The replay suite selects which base cases are entry-free with the new dispatch's own _is_unmigrated predicate, so a wrong refusal of an entry-free case would drop it from the replay instead of failing.

findings.actual_failure: dispatch exits 1 with a traceback and no result where the base printed decision none; the MCP tool reports configuration_mismatch
findings.observation: A deeply nested dotted-key workspace.toml parses, then the unbounded recursive entry walk raises RecursionError outside the refusal handler.
findings.reachable_path: any dispatch run, or the MCP tool, over a repository whose workspace.toml nests a few hundred dotted-key levels
findings.rule_ref: dispatch.py contract: exit 0 with a printed result or exit 2; AC-0002

findings.actual_failure: the whole file is read into memory
findings.observation: Artifact header reads use read_text with no byte cap instead of file_safety.read_confined_regular_file.
findings.reachable_path: a hostile repository with a very large spec.md read by dispatch or the in-process MCP tool

findings.actual_failure: a port regression in captured-directory confinement, the re-check before open or the cooled no-read rule passes every remaining test
findings.observation: Seventeen direct list_captured_items cases (symlinked or non-directory captured paths, hard links, check-then-open swap, overlong path echo, cooled entries, ignored names and order) were deleted and not retargeted to the ported listing.
findings.reachable_path: dispatch.py --captured and the Step 0 shaping-item guard
findings.rule_ref: plan.md suite fates: a surviving case is retargeted with its assertion unchanged

findings.actual_failure: a repair regression leaving a residual entry takes the refusal branch and passes
findings.observation: The AC-0030 helper chooses the expected outcome from the applied workspace.toml it is checking.
findings.rule_ref: test design: an assertion must be able to fail
